title: oenothera laevigata var. scitula
intro: Oenothera laevigata var. scitula, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a perennial plant species native to North America. This plant is valued for its seed oil, which is rich in gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), an essential fatty acid with anti-inflammatory properties. The health benefits of Evening Primrose oil include relief from menopausal symptoms, skin conditions such as eczema and acne, and inflammation-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of Oenothera laevigata var. scitula include GLA, linoleic acid, and other polyunsaturated fatty acids, which exert therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and emollient effects.
